subject_pixels_across.source: Unverified against a DJI Fly export
subject_pixels_across.rationale: Without an explicit --gsd, altitude is chosen so the subject's HEIGHT spans at least this many pixels in one nadir frame, so a small subject is flown close rather than at the legal ceiling. When that puts the aircraft below min_obstacle_clearance_m the tool refuses and points at capture_plan.py, which is the honest answer for a subject too small to fly. Provisional: verify against a real reconstruction before it becomes policy.
